title: Casper and the Orchard
author: Ivo Oyelaran
blurb: Vesper Zhou, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
